root_cause.text: A race condition during GPU recovery allows the TDR work queue to free the `amdgpu_job` structure (after `drm_sched_start()` is called) before the scheduler timeout callback `amdgpu_device_gpu_recover()` completes, leading to a use-after-free when dereferencing `job->pasid`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the direct dereference of `job->pasid` with a cached local variable `pasid` initialized at the start of `amdgpu_device_gpu_recover()`, accompanied by a comment stating: "The job may already be freed at this point via the sched tdr workqueue so use the cached pasid."
